# #ioa://teologia.ai · agent entrypoint
> Theology as agentic environments. One human principal per environment. Agents read, cite and propose; humans teach and decide.

- Network: ./ae.json (ae.network/0.1). Follow environments[].manifest.
- escuela: courses (Catecismo Menor first). Agents may summarize, quiz, propose study plans.
- biblioteca: library and reading paths. Agents may search, cite, recommend.
- gospel: bookstore expression; real checkout happens only on the store's site, approved by the buyer.

Rules: never claim church or institutional authority. Name the Bible translation when quoting. Doctrine, grades and publishing are human_only.
Evidence ≠ Authority. #ioa #internetofagents #opensourceware
